title: #018. Multidimensional Knapsack with Dependencies
subtitle: Pack 0-1 features across multiple resource limits while obeying prerequisite and incompatibility pairs.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selected, totalValue }.
judge.m3: Prerequisite violated: selecting item {p0} requires selecting item {p1}.
judge.m4: Incompatibility violated: items {p0} and {p1} cannot both be selected.
judge.m5: Reported totalValue ({p0}) does not match computed value ({p1}).
judge.m6: Feasible selection, but totalValue ({p0}) is below optimal ({p1}).
